title: GeoNetwork Fixes Unauthenticated RCE Chain Affecting Government Geoportal Backends
summary: Two vulnerabilities in GeoNetwork can be chained to achieve unauthenticated remote code execution (RCE) on the open-source geospatial metadata catalog, which sits behind many government and agency geoportals.
card_summary: Two vulnerabilities in GeoNetwork can be chained to achieve unauthenticated remote code execution (RCE) on the open-source geospatial metadata catalog, which sits behind many government and agency geoportals.

sections.mitigation: The project shipped fixes in versions 4.4.12 and 4.2.17 on July 8, 2026, and published the vulnerability details on August 31.

email_summary: Two vulnerabilities in GeoNetwork can be chained to achieve unauthenticated remote code execution (RCE) on the open-source geospatial metadata catalog, which sits behind many government and agency geoportals. Severity is rated critical.

title: Extradited Russian Hacker Faces Charges Over Excel Malware Campaign That Infected Thousands
summary: The U.S. Department of Justice (DoJ) has charged a Russian national, extradited from Cyprus on August 28, with using roughly 255 fake accounts on a freelance platform to send malware-laced Excel attachments to about 80,000 of its users in 2016 and 2017.

title: Researchers Use Claude to Port Pre-Auth RCE Exploit From One PLC Model to Another

title: Authorities Turn Sality's P2P Network Against Itself, Cutting Off New Malware Payloads
summary: The U.S. Department of Justice (DoJ) on Tuesday announced the takedown of a long-standing peer-to-peer (P2P) botnet known as Sality as part of a coordinated law enforcement operation.
